name.ja: <ruby>海晶乙女<rt>マリンセス</rt></ruby>ブルークリスタルハート

text.en:
2 "Marincess" monsters
(This card is always treated as "Marincess Crystal Heart".)
You can target 1 "Marincess" Link Monster in your GY; Special Summon it to your zone this card points to. If this card is sent to the GY as material for a Link-3 or higher "Marincess" Link Monster: You can send 1 "Marincess" card from your Deck to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Marincess Blue Crystal Heart" once per turn.
